title: Te Pikinga o te Moemoeā
intro: He wairua kua whakaritea kia nui, engari i whakamatautauria e ngā whakamātautau nui, i tīmata i tētahi haerenga whakamiharo. I tohuhia te ara o tēnei tangata e te hae, te wehenga, me te mamae hē, ā, i mutu i roto i tētahi tūranga kawenga nui me te huihuinga hohonu. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata whakamiharo mai i te Quran?
clues: I haea ahau e te hunga e tata ana ki ahau i mua, ā, i tino wehea ahau i ōku mātua me tōku kāinga.
I pā mai tētahi wā uaua nui ki ahau, tae atu ki te hokonga atu i ahau mō tētahi utu iti e ngā kairāwhiti.
I whakapaetia hētia ahau mō te mahi hē, ā, i noho ahau i roto i te whare herehere mō ngā tau maha, heoi, i mau tonu tōku whakapono.
I whakawhiwhia ahau ki tētahi pūkenga ahurei ki te whakamārama i ngā kitenga uaua, ā, i kitea he mea nui tēnei i roto i tōku ara ki te herekoretanga.
Nā tōku whakaaro nui me tōku ngākau tapatahi i ārahi ahau ki tētahi tūranga mana nui me te whakawhirinakitanga i tētahi whenua ke.
Nā te maha o ngā kaupapa i tūtaki anō ai ahau ki ōku mātua kua kaumātuatia me ōku teina, tuākana hoki, whai muri i te ngaro roa, mamae hoki.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
